The '''Great Municipal Band''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Band/Legends|band]] that performed at all major events significant to the Gungans, who were a swamp-dwelling species on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was a source of extreme pride for the Gungan people as only the finest [[musikagung]]s were members. The band was a significant part of Gungan culture, as it composed [[symponik]]s to record and retell Gungan history. The Great Municipal Band was directed by a leader, and in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] that leader was [[Augara Jowil/Legends|Augara Jowil]], who succeeded [[Beezar Pert/Legends|Beezar Pert]], composer of the "[[Symponika Crunchen-Grand]]." Under Jowil's direction, the Municipal Band performed the "[[Symponik Nabooalla]]" following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] megacorporation known as the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].

==History==
[[File:Augieincrowd.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Augara Jowil (pictured) was instructed by Beezar Pert.]]
The Great Municipal [[Band/Legends|Band]] was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] band composed of the finest [[musikagung]]s, the [[Musician/Legends|musicians]] of the swamp-dwelling [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] species, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="DB" /> Sometime prior to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the band was under the conduction of [[Beezar Pert/Legends|Beezar Pert]], composer of the famous "[[Symponika Crunchen-Grand]]," a [[symponik]] detailing the events of the formation of the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]]. Pert took the young musikagung [[Augara Jowil/Legends|Augara "Augie" Jowil]] as<ref name="DB" /> his<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|175|Jowil, Augarra [''sic''] 'Augie'&thinsp;}}</ref> apprentice and instructed her until he retired. Despite Jowil's relative youth and inexperience, the members of the band unanimously elected her to succeed Pert.<ref name="DB" />

During 32 BBY's<ref name="NEC" /> [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Jowil and the band evacuated the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]], along with the rest of the city's population, and fled from the invading [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]].<ref name="DB" /> There, Jowil got her chance to chronicle the historical event she never thought would come: the meeting of the Gungan [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] led by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in order to regain freedom for the entire planet.<ref name="CSWE" /> Jowil composed the entire "[[Symponik Nabooalla]]," an epic for all of Naboo's denizens, in her [[Brain/Legends|head]] within [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. The piece's first movement debuted during the Municipal Band's [[Parade/Legends|parade]] performance during the victory celebration in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] after the Naboo and Gungans defeated the Trade Federation.<ref name="DB" /> The band's performance was witnessed by representatives of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] such as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref name="TPM" /> That ensured Jowil's place in history as one of the group's most important leaders.<ref name="DB" />

==Organization==
The Great Municipal Band was composed of the finest musikagungs.<ref name="DB" /> It contained [[Drum/Legends|drum]] and [[bawoonka]] sections<ref name="FF108">{{FactFile|108|VIC 1-4|Victory on Naboo}}</ref> and had at least forty-two [[percussion]]ists and several bawoonka players who were able to play while marching. The band also contained a [[choir]]<ref name="TPM" /> and was led by a conductor and headquartered in the city of Otoh Gunga on Naboo.<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Great Municipal Band made its first appearance in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] during the movie's final scene depicting the victory parade in the city of Theed,<ref name="TPM" /> but was first named in the title of the last track of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (soundtrack)|the film's soundtrack]], "Augie's Great Municipal Band."<ref name="TPMS">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (soundtrack)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' soundtrack]]</ref>
